name: Challenge Networks
summary: Melbourne (Blackburn/Abbotsford, VIC) enterprise & private wireless (3G/4G/LTE) network provider specialising in mining-sector solutions; not a retail ISP; reportedly acquired by Vocus.

events.details: Brand site challengenetworks.com.au footer ©2003 Communications Services Pty Ltd; earliest capture Nov 2007. NOTE: challenge.net.au was Challenge Chemicals Australia (WA) — wrong domain.

Reportedly acquired by Vocus (no primary source located to confirm date). Still operating as an enterprise LTE/private-network provider at the Jan 2019 capture ('preeminent enterprise LTE network provider'; COMMSDAY 2018 Edison Award nominee); an active CHALLENGE NETWORKS RESOURCES PTY LTD (ABN 51 640 357 213, VIC 3067) also exists.
